Whether you want to keep track of your team’s big match, stay up to date with all the latest news, kick back and watch some epic viral videos or simply test your footy knowledge with a variety of games… We’ve got you covered.

MEDIA
433 changes the rules of the game by offering you content from within the locker room. This unique angle allows us to deliver behind-the-scenes footage of the world’s biggest clubs, while bringing you closer than ever to your favourite players. Our media feature provides you with exclusive content and tells you the stories you had never heard before. In essence, we aim to provide the 433 community with the greatest moments that ‘The Beautiful Game’ has to offer, moments that before 433 had never been available to football fans.

What you can enjoy in our media section:
- Podcast
- Player Documentaries
- Short Films
- 433 Awards
- Player Takeovers
- Player Interviews
- Funny Clips

MATCHES
Follow your favorite club, keep track of their fixtures & results and check out the match stats that matter. Which team dominated possession? Who had the highest xG? How many of their shots hit the target? How many yellow cards did the referee dish out? It’s all in there.

Get up-to-date information such as:
- Scores
- Line-ups
- Game Stats
- League Standings

QUIZZES
Do you know everything there is to know about football? There’s only one way to find out. Put your football knowledge to the test with a flurry of quizzes, interactive games & brain teasers. Who knows more about football: You or your friends? Time to settle it once and for all…

NEWS
Stay on top of the news and never miss any breaking stories coming out of your favourite league or club. Keep track of your team’s transfer developments, injury updates, unmissable quotes & reactions from across the football world. 

The 433 app will provide you with fun & easy-to-read news from your favourite clubs, leagues and players. Be the first to find out about trending stories or when a transfer is nearing the ‘Here we go!’.
